answer: An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 4 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Because the jetty count is verified against the bridge text itself, the oasis audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 173 aliases therefore means producing 173 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
